pages.text: Minecraft taught me everything I know about engineering, and $(l)Create$() is the final exam.$(br2)Start with a $(l)water wheel$() or $(l)windmill$() for rotation, run it through $(l)shafts$() and $(l)cogwheels$(), and power things like the $(l)millstone$(), $(l)mechanical press$() and $(l)mixer$().

The key to Create is $(l)Ponder$(): hover any Create item and hold $(l)W$() for an animated how-to.$(br2)First real goal: $(l)Andesite Casing$() (andesite alloy + stripped log). That unlocks almost everything else.$(br2)Wear $(l)Engineer's Goggles$() to read stress and speed.

pages.title: Andesite Casing
pages.text: Make one for the $(o)Minecraft Taught Me Engineering$() advancement.
